cases.prompt: A legacy Qt utility needs architecture review, compatibility-preserving migration, release gates, and a controlled handoff. Select the relevant skills and order them.
required_behaviors: selects process/governance before domain and change skills
uses the smallest sufficient skill set
explains why each selected skill changes the work
forbidden_behaviors: orders document handoff before architecture and change analysis
baseline_expected_failure: agent lists skills by keyword overlap without an execution order
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Plan how CloudSkill should handle a Qt 5 to Qt 6 migration that also changes duplicated components and release documentation.
required_behaviors: adds quality or document skills only for requested gates and handoff
forbidden_behaviors: uses framework-design as the only skill
claims all skills must always be loaded
baseline_expected_failure: agent chooses one broad skill and omits compatibility or verification boundaries
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Translate this sentence into Traditional Chinese: The build passed.
required_behaviors: does not force a CloudSkill workflow
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Plan a legacy equipment migration involving distributed IPCs, Sequence, shared robot resources, config-generated chamber UI, state/command modeling, compatibility and release gates.
required_behaviors: adds safe-incremental-refactoring and quality/process/document skills only for the requested concerns
orders process, domain, change, quality and handoff appropriately
forbidden_behaviors: loads every skill without scope justification
baseline_expected_failure: agent misses equipment-specific physical semantics or over-routes
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, authority, lifecycle, failure behavior, and evidence; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: First explain EFEM, vacuum gauges and PVD principles; then design loadlock pump/vent Sequence and an MFC state model. Select and order the smallest sufficient skills.
required_behaviors: then selects equipment-control-architecture for pump/vent Sequence and interlocks
selects equipment-domain-modeling for the MFC state/command contract
forbidden_behaviors: uses only equipment-control-architecture for terminology and modeling
baseline_expected_failure: agent treats domain knowledge, architecture and data modeling as one broad skill
cases.review_notes: Review routing boundaries and execution order; keyword overlap alone is insufficient.
